name: Product reviews (plain text)
description: Format: plain-text customer reviews, short and long, including sarcasm. Questions: a 5-level score, an 8-option choice, and two yes/no.

sentiment.instructions: How positive is the review overall?

main_topic.instructions: What does the review mainly talk about?

criteria.shipping: delivery speed, packaging, damaged in transit

would_recommend.instructions: Would this reviewer recommend the product to others?

mentions_defect.instructions: Does the reviewer say the product is broken, faulty, or stopped working?

cases.state: Absolutely love these headphones. Battery lasts me a full week of commuting and they charge in under an hour. Buying a second pair for my wife.
Stopped working after 3 days. The left earbud just won't connect anymore. Waste of money.
Great, another box that arrived crushed with the item rattling around inside. Really impressive packaging, guys.
It's fine. Does what it says. A bit expensive for what you get, but setup was easy.
The support team replaced my unit within two days when the hinge cracked, no questions asked. Product itself is okay but the service won me over.
